content:
Parabola turns real objects into equations, from park fountains to headlight reflectors. JEE mixes latus rectum, focal chords and directrix questions almost every year. Take the free JEE Parabola online test below. It offers 15 exam-pattern MCQs with instant scoring and worked answers. Push for 12 out of 15, then close the gaps.

What JEE asks from Parabola

  • Standard forms and the direction a parabola opens.
  • Focus, directrix and the length of the latus rectum.
  • Focal chord length from the parameter t.
  • Real world modelling with arches and reflectors.
  • Locus problems that neatly define a parabola.
  • Tangent and normal lines at a point on the curve.

Formulas and facts to revise first

  • For y squared equals 4ax the focus lies at distance a from the vertex.
  • The latus rectum length equals four times a.
  • A focal chord length uses a times t plus one over t, squared.
  • The directrix never touches the parabola it defines.
  • The semi latus rectum is the harmonic mean of the focal chord segments.

Mistakes that cost JEE marks

  • Reading a sign wrong and opening the parabola the wrong way.
  • Mixing up four a with a while placing the focus.
  • Forgetting the directrix sits opposite the focus across the vertex.
  • Skipping the vertex shift in a translated parabola.

quiz.title: JEE Parabola Quiz
quiz.intro: Fifteen exam-pattern questions. Pick an answer for each, then press Check my score.

questions.q: The parabola x² = 4ay passes through (2, 1). Its latus rectum length is:
questions.explanation: Substituting (2, 1) gives 4 = 4a. The latus rectum length 4a is then 4 units.

questions.q: Find the axis of symmetry of 3x² + 4y = 0.
questions.explanation: The curve is x² = −(4/3)y, opening downwards from the origin. So its axis is x = 0.

questions.q: A fountain sprays a parabolic arc with vertex (5, 5) and lands 10 m away. Find its equation.
questions.explanation: The arc starts at (0, 0), which fixes 4a = 5. So the equation is (x − 5)² = −5(y − 5).

questions.q: Find the distance between the focus and the directrix of x² = −16y.
questions.explanation: Here 4a = 16, so a = 4. The focus to directrix gap is 2a, which is 8 units.

questions.q: Which point lies on the directrix of (y − 2)² = 8(x − 3)?
questions.explanation: The parabola opens right with directrix x = 1. Only (1, 2) fits that line.

questions.q: A ball follows y = 2x − 0.1x² in metres. Find its maximum height.
questions.explanation: Completing the square gives a vertex at (10, 10). So the peak height is 10 m.

questions.q: For y² = 8x, the focal chord with one end at t = 2 has length:
A circle drawn on any focal chord of a parabola as diameter always touches the:
questions.explanation: This is a standard property. Such a circle always touches the directrix.

questions.q: A truck headlight reflector is 20 cm wide and 5 cm deep. How far from the vertex is the bulb?
questions.explanation: With y² = 4ax and rim point (5, 10), we get a = 5. So the focus sits 5 cm from the vertex.

questions.q: For y² = 44x, the focal chord with one end at t = 2 has length:
The parabola x² = −4ay with a > 0 opens:
questions.explanation: The x² term with a negative y coefficient means the parabola opens downwards.

questions.q: The centre of a circle that touches a fixed line and passes through a fixed point traces a:
questions.explanation: The centre stays equidistant from the point and the line. That definition gives a parabola.

questions.q: A parabola has vertex (−2, 2), passes through (−6, 6) and opens left. Find its focus.
questions.explanation: The point fixes a = 1. So the focus sits one unit left of the vertex, at (−3, 2).

questions.q: Does the directrix of x² = 4ay ever meet the parabola?
options: Depends on the value of a
questions.explanation: The parabola needs y ≥ 0, but the directrix is y = −a. So they never meet.

questions.q: The semi latus rectum of a parabola is the ______ of the two focal chord segments.
questions.explanation: A standard result names the semi latus rectum the harmonic mean of the two segments.
